name: cl_Pt19
title: Pt19 cluster
description: Gas-phase Pt19. PBE and hybrid DFT give a Pt18 three-layer trigonal prism capped on a triangular face (C3v; Kumar & Kawazoe, PRB 77, 205418 (2008); J. Mol. Model. (2024), doi:10.1007/s00894-024-06099-5). NEP89 instead prefers a hollow 19-vertex deltahedral cage (all atoms 5- or 6-coordinated, Pt-Pt 2.53-2.57 A), 1.5 eV below the relaxed DFT structure and 0.66 eV below the fcc octahedron, so this landscape is NEP89-specific.
